name: Lock → On Lock
description:
An automation to perform when the lock is locked. See [`lock.on_lock` / `lock.on_unlock` Trigger](https://esphome.io/components/lock/#lock-on_lock_unlock_trigger).

This trigger is activated each time the lock is locked/unlocked. It becomes active right after the lock component has acknowledged the state (e.g. after it LOCKED/UNLOCKED itself).
